test_code:
import sys
import pytest
from colorama.ansitowin32 import AnsiToWin32

def test_ansitowin32_windows_console_handle():
    if sys.platform != 'win32':
        pytest.skip('Requires Windows OS kernel32 console APIs')
    a = AnsiToWin32(sys.stdout)
    assert a.has_reduced_output()
